title: Shape retry when a malformed report also asks the owner
lead: *Proposed.* S275 (landed 2026-11-04, `9865f1e`) already resumes the implementer, reviewer, gate, architect and UI pass once in the same session on a shape-only report error. It skips that retry whenever the report also carries an owner question, and pauses at once. On 2026-11-04 that case caused most of the shape pauses seen after the S275 build. This slice extends the one same-session retry to a malformed report that also asks the owner. Then the owner sees one well-formed question, or a shape pause after the retry. What happens to the question during the retry, and whether S243's part (b) is dropped, are open: see `Open owner questions`.
findings_note: Owner 2026-11-04 (prism-ui wave): shape pauses in implementer, reviewer and gate; the orchestrator ran ork retry up to 6 times per run. S275 (landed 2026-11-04) covers shape-only reports; after its build the remaining pauses were malformed reports that also asked the owner (round.go:539-541 skips the retry then). Spec-check version: S266. S243 part (b) is now S275.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the spec check's own retry (S266, `internal/engine/speccheck.go`); the `[owner]` body rule itself (S288); changing `CheckReport`, `Triage` or `TriageGate`; prompt text (S276, S277); a second automatic retry; any change to how a well-formed question pauses.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner evidence, 2026-11-04 (prism-ui wave, Claude Sonnet implementers, Claude Opus reviewers and gates): shape pauses in the implementer, reviewer and gate, and an orchestrator monitor that ran `ork retry` up to 6 times per run to get past them. Read from the run records under `~/.local/state/ork/runs/` on 2026-11-04:

- The daemon started on the S275 build at 18:39Z (`ps`: `ork daemon run` started 13:39 -0500; `~/bin/ork` built 13:39). The U23, U27 and U29 attempts before that time (implementer attempts 2 and 3, U27 reviewer attempts 2 to 6) ran on the old build, which paused on every shape error. S275 covers the shape-only ones.
- After 18:39Z, U26's reviewer (`reviewer-1.md`) wrote an `[owner]` finding whose body was `- Options:` with nested bullets, and also an `## Owner needed` question. The run paused. Attempt 2 started 16 s later and fixed the shape. U31's gate wrote an `[owner blocker]` with prose before or after the block, plus an `## Owner needed` question, in attempts 1 to 3. The question was recorded only after attempt 4 (19:18:38Z).
- The code: in the shape branch (`internal/engine/round.go:532-551`) of `runRound` the automatic retry runs only when `isNone(body)` for `## Owner needed` and `tri` has no owner findings (`round.go:539-541`). A failed `Triage` leaves `tri` nil, so a malformed `[owner]` finding alone still retries. Any non-empty `## Owner needed` section blocks the retry. That includes a well-formed question next to a malformed finding, or a missing Tests line. `TestShapeProblemWithAQuestionStillPausesForTheOwner` (`internal/engine/round_test.go:245`) pins this. S275's spec chose it as a guard ("existing behavior guard"), so changing it is the owner's call (Q1).
- The retry brief (`internal/engine/round.go:143-144`) is the `## Report shape` case of `pendingKindSection`: "ork checked your last report and refused it: REASON ... Write the report again". It does not tell the role to keep its question.

S266 (spec check) and S243 part (b):

- S266 is title-only (findings: the spec check's retry runs from scratch, the retry loop at `internal/engine/speccheck.go:145-157` in `RunSpecCheck`; proposed: resume the same session with the shape error). Shared design: one same-session resume, with the shape problems as the brief, then a pause. Shared code: this slice moves the brief body into one helper, `shapeRetryBrief(reason string) string`, in `round.go`. S266 can call it from `speccheck.go`. The two slices touch different files (this one: `round.go` and its tests; S266: `speccheck.go` and its tests), so they do not conflict. This one lands first: it is smaller and reuses S275's marker. S266 then imports the helper. Not verified: whether the spec-check runner keeps a resumable session id. S266's spec must check it.
- S243 part (b) ("one automatic report nudge") is now what S275 does. S243's spec still says to add it at `round.go:489` with its own tests (`nudge_test.go`). Whether S243 drops part (b) is Q2.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/round.go:532-551` (the shape branch of `runRound`: the retry condition) and `:136-149` (`pendingKindSection`: the `## Report shape` body moves to `shapeRetryBrief`; it gains one sentence when the refused report asked the owner).
- `internal/runrec/record.go:154` (`Pending`; no new field expected: the refused report's question text is read from the refused report itself. Confirm at start).
- `internal/engine/round_test.go` (harness `newHarness`, `internal/engine/harness_test.go:195`).
- `internal/engine/kinds_test.go` (a reviewer and a gate case).
- `docs/design.md:570-584` (Report checks: the S275 paragraph's "A malformed report with an owner question pauses immediately").

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
In `internal/engine/round_test.go`:

- `TestShapeProblemWithAQuestionRetriesOnce` (Q1 option 1): the implementer report has a valid `## Owner needed` question and no Tests line, then a good report with the same question. Exactly two implementer requests: same round, resumed session `sess-implementer`, and a `## Report shape` brief that names the missing Tests line and says to keep the question. The run then pauses with kind `question` and the question recorded once. Fails first: one request and a `shape` pause.
- `TestShapeProblemWithAQuestionPausesAfterTheRetry`: both reports are malformed and ask. Two requests, then a `shape` pause with the automatic marker cleared. Fails first: one request.
- Rename and invert `TestShapeProblemWithAQuestionStillPausesForTheOwner` (`round_test.go:245`) to the Q1 answer. Under option 1 it becomes the test above. Under option 3 it stays as it is.
- `TestShapeRetryBriefSaysKeepTheQuestion`: `shapeRetryBrief` with a refused report that asks the owner contains "Keep your owner question" (*proposed* wording), and without a question it is byte-for-byte today's text. Fails first: the helper does not exist.

In `internal/engine/kinds_test.go`:

- `TestMalformedOwnerFindingBesideAQuestionRetriesOnce`: the reviewer writes `- [owner] Which one?` with no options (as `TestMalformedOwnerFindingPausesOnAShapeError`, `internal/engine/kinds_test.go:205`) plus a valid `## Owner needed` question, then a good report. Two reviewer requests, then the question pause. Fails first: a `shape` pause after one request.
- Same for the gate, with `[owner blocker]`: `TestMalformedGateBlockerBesideAQuestionRetriesOnce`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Tests first. Confirm each fails for the reason given.
2. Extract `shapeRetryBrief(reason string, asked bool) string` from the Report shape case (`internal/engine/round.go:143-144`) of `pendingKindSection`. With `asked` false it returns today's text unchanged. With `asked` true it adds one sentence (*proposed*): "Keep your owner question as it was; fix only the shape."
3. In the shape branch (`round.go:539-541`), drop the `isNone(body)` and `len(tri.Owner) == 0` conditions under Q1 option 1. Keep the guard that stops a second automatic attempt for the same role and round. Set `asked` when the `## Owner needed` body is not none or the refused report has an `[owner]` tag line.
4. Under Q1 option 2, instead record a parseable question and pause on it, and carry the shape problems into the answer brief. Write that option's tests after the answer.
5. Do not change `CheckReport`, `Triage`, `TriageGate`, the prompts or `speccheck.go`.
6. Update the S275 paragraph in `docs/design.md` (Report checks) in the same diff.

Owner decisions (2026-11-11): Who runs this slice's focused test line and the mutation step? -> orchestrator: keep `go -C WORKTREE test -count=1 ./internal/engine -run 'ShapeProblem|ShapeRetry|MalformedOwner|MalformedGate'` and the mutation step as written, and assign both to the orchestrator to run.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go -C WORKTREE test -count=1 ./internal/engine -run 'ShapeProblem|ShapeRetry|MalformedOwner|MalformedGate'`: all pass.
- `go -C WORKTREE test -race -count=1 ./...`, `go -C WORKTREE vet ./...`, `gofmt -l WORKTREE` (empty), `slicer check`, `adj lint`.
- Mutation: restore the `isNone(body)` condition; `TestShapeProblemWithAQuestionRetriesOnce` goes red. Drop the `asked` sentence; `TestShapeRetryBriefSaysKeepTheQuestion` goes red.
- [HUMAN CHECK] [AFTER LAND] On the next wave with Claude reviewers or gates, a report with a malformed `[owner]` finding and an `## Owner needed` question shows "shape retry" once and then asks the owner, with no `ork retry` by hand.

sections.heading: Open owner questions
sections.body:
No adj record exists yet for this rule (S275 recorded its own answers in its Why, key `engine.shape-retry`, `adj check` not found).

Question: What should ork do with a malformed report that also asks the owner?
Options:
1. retry-first: resume the role once with the shape problems and the note to keep its question, then ask or pause
2. ask-now: when the question parses, ask it at once and send the shape problems with the answer
3. keep: pause at once as S275 does today, and only the reason says ork retry resends the shape error
Recommend: 1 - the owner then sees one well-formed question and no hand retry, and it reuses S275's marker unchanged

Question: S275 already does S243's part (b), the one automatic report nudge. What happens to S243?
Options:
1. drop-part-b: edit S243 to remove part (b) and its nudge_test.go tests, keeping parts (a) and (c)
2. keep: leave S243 as written and let its implementer find the overlap
Recommend: 1 - part (b) is done, and its spec would add a second retry path beside S275's
